verdict.rationale: Public, agent-readable docs (llms.txt and .md pages both return HTTP 200) document an async pre-recorded quickstart where a method takes a local file, binary data, or remote URL and handles the rest. The official CLI goes from key to transcript in one command (`gladia transcribe audio.mp3`) with machine-readable JSON output for scripts, so an agent holding a key can complete the flow without a human step. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the raw REST auth header, job-creation and result-polling endpoints; a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths 404); independent or hands-on confirmation of an end-to-end agent run.
